body:
# 💎 CrystalSizes 💎

Take control of your End Crystal visuals! **CrystalSizes** is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that allows you to dynamically scale and resize End Crystals in real-time. 

Perfect for PvP players who want smaller, less intrusive crystals for cleaner line-of-sight, or builders and creators looking to make massive, epic-looking ritual crystals! 🛠️✨

---

## 🌟 Features

* 🔄 **Dynamic Scaling:** Change the size of End Crystals to whatever scale you want!
* 🎛️ **In-Game Configuration:** No need to restart your game—adjust your settings on the fly via a clean, user-friendly in-game configuration screen.
* ⌨️ **Quick Hotkey:** Access the config menu instantly at any time by pressing **`K`** (fully rebindable in your Minecraft controls menu!).
* 🖥️ **Purely Client-Side:** Since it only changes how crystals render on *your* screen, you can use this on any server, vanilla or modded, without being banned or needing the server to install it! 

---

## 🛠️ How to Use

1.  Jump into any world or server! 🌍
2.  Press **`K`** on your keyboard to open the **CrystalSizes Config Screen** 💻
3.  Toggle the scaling mod **On/Off** and adjust your custom scale multiplier 📊
4.  Save and enjoy your brand new crystal visuals! 💎

---

## 📦 Requirements & Compatibility

* **Loader:** Fabric ⚙️
* **Side:** Client-Side Only 🖥️ (Do not install on servers!)
* **Dependencies:** Fabric API
